title: Suitcases to Osaka · Akihabara retro & figures · Ameyoko sneakers & day drinks · Christmas market under Tokyo Tower · Keyakizaka lights · gyoza feast · ZEROTOKYO Steve Angello

stops.name: Ninja House: send suitcases to Kujō House (Yamato TA-Q-BIN)
stops.plan: Send the big suitcases with Yamato TA-Q-BIN for Mon 21 evening delivery at Kujō House; keep overnight bags for Hakone. Bring original passports for tonight.
stops.transport: Walk to Higashi-Nagasaki, Seibu Ikebukuro line → Ikebukuro, JR Yamanote line → Otsuka, about 39 min

stops.name: Onigiri Bongo
stops.plan: Pick up the takeaway order phoned in the day before (03-3910-5617) and eat on the move; skip the dine-in queue.
stops.transport: JR Yamanote line Otsuka → Akihabara, about 32 min door to door

stops.name: Super Potato Retro-kan
stops.plan: Three floors of Famicom, Game Boy and N64 stock plus the top-floor retro arcade; go in two groups of four.

stops.name: Mandarake Complex + Radio Kaikan
stops.plan: Mandarake at its noon opening for secondhand figures and manga, then Radio Kaikan's figure, card and gachapon floors; split by interest and regroup out front.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Ginza line Suehirocho → Ueno-hirokoji, walk to Ameyoko, about 22 min door to door

stops.name: mita sneakers & Ameyoko
stops.plan: mita's collab sneakers under the tracks (3–4 inside at a time), the rest browse the cheap sneaker and jacket stalls.

stops.name: Ameyoko izakaya strip (Daitoryo + Uokusa)
stops.plan: Motsu-yaki skewers and beer at Daitoryo (expect 4+4), then standing seafood and sake at Uokusa.
stops.transport: JR Keihin-Tohoku line (rapid) Ueno → Hamamatsucho, walk to Shiba Park, about 34 min

stops.name: Tokyo Christmas Market – Shiba Park
stops.plan: Weekday advance tickets for 8 (with mug); mulled wine and sausages as Tokyo Tower lights up at dusk.
stops.transport: Walk to Kamiyacho, Tokyo Metro Hibiya line → Roppongi, about 36 min door to door

stops.name: Roppongi Hills Christmas Market + Keyakizaka illumination
stops.plan: Glühwein at the Oyane Plaza market, then the Keyakizaka light tunnel with Tokyo Tower at the end for the group photo.
stops.price: Free entry; glühwein and food ¥800–1,500 each
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Hibiya line Roppongi → Kasumigaseki, Marunouchi line → Shinjuku, walk to Kabukicho, about 42 min

stops.name: Shinjuku Mugen Gyoza
stops.category_label: Dinner (all you can eat and drink)
stops.plan: Booked 20:40 private room for 8 (Hot Pepper) on the busiest bōnenkai night: gyoza, dim sum and free-flow drinks for 2 hours.
stops.transport: Walk 4 min to Tokyu Kabukicho Tower

stops.name: ZEROTOKYO: THE ONE presents Steve Angello
stops.plan: Advance tickets bought; queue from about 22:30 with original passports, dance through the 00:30–03:00 peak.
stops.transport: Taxi to Ninja House, 2 cars, 21 min (about ¥4,700 per car)

stops.name: Ninja House
stops.plan: Sleep; pack the overnight bags for the 10:00 check-out and Hakone.
